ai_hints: Docker/Compose: running as root, unpinned or :latest base images, secrets baked into layers/ENV/ARG, large attack surface (build tools in the final stage, missing multi-stage), missing HEALTHCHECK, COPY . . pulling in .env/.git, exposed ports and mounted docker.sock.

message.es: Builds no reproducibles y cambios inesperados. Fija versión (y idealmente digest).
message.en: Non-reproducible builds and surprise changes. Pin a version (ideally a digest).

message.es: Crea y usa un usuario sin privilegios en la etapa final.
message.en: Create and use an unprivileged user in the final stage.

message.es: Descarga sin verificación de integridad. Usa curl/wget con checksum o COPY de un artefacto verificado.
message.en: Downloads without integrity verification. Use curl/wget with a checksum or COPY a verified artifact.

message.es: Queda en las capas/historial de la imagen. Usa BuildKit --mount=type=secret o secretos en runtime.
message.en: It stays in image layers/history. Use BuildKit --mount=type=secret or runtime secrets.

message.es: Instala paquetes innecesarios y agranda la imagen.
message.en: Installs unneeded packages and bloats the image.

match: RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl

message.es: Equivale a acceso root al host. Evita montarlo o usa un proxy restringido.
message.en: Equivalent to root access on the host. Avoid mounting it or use a restricted proxy.
